description: 1. Main processes simulated Sea-ice component of KIOST-ESM2, the Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory (GFDL) Sea Ice Simulator version 2 (SIS2), configured consistently with the GFDL ESM4.1 framework and run on the MOM6 0.5° ocean grid. It simulates sea-ice thermodynamics, sea-ice dynamics and iceberg processes.  2. Key physics/parameterizations Compared with SIS, SIS2 includes improved representations of sea-ice thermodynamics, dynamics and iceberg processes, providing a more physically consistent coupling between the ocean and sea-ice components.  3. Notable features of this version In KIOST-ESM2 the sea-ice component has been upgraded from the Sea Ice Simulator (SIS) used in KIOST-ESM1 to SIS2, following the GFDL ESM4.1 configuration.
